title: Metabolic Vulnerabilities in S. aureus Biofilms - Open Co-Scientist
description: What mechanisms drive antibiotic resistance in Staphylococcus aureus biofilms, and which metabolic pathways could be targeted to restore susceptibility?
heading: Metabolic Vulnerabilities in S. aureus Biofilms
goal: What mechanisms drive antibiotic resistance in Staphylococcus aureus biofilms, and which metabolic pathways could be targeted to restore susceptibility?
summary: The proposals converge on metabolic state as a modulator of tolerance, but each needs strain-aware validation in a mature biofilm model before any translational interpretation. The ranked program deliberately keeps competing mechanisms separate, then uses perturbation, rescue, and independent-model replication to decide which should advance.

ideas.title: Metabolic wake-up before vancomycin exposure
ideas.statement: A short, non-growth-promoting metabolic pulse before vancomycin may reduce tolerance in mature S. aureus biofilms.

ideas.title: MazEF state predicts a tolerant biofilm subpopulation
ideas.statement: MazEF-associated transcriptional state may identify the biofilm cells that survive bactericidal antibiotic pulses.

ideas.title: Matrix-restricted nutrient access creates a reversible tolerance niche
ideas.statement: Nutrient gradients within the matrix may create a reversible low-energy niche that can be selectively disrupted.

title: Adolescent Prefrontal Circuit Refinement - Open Co-Scientist
description: How does synaptic pruning in the prefrontal cortex contribute to cognitive flexibility during adolescent development?
heading: Adolescent Prefrontal Circuit Refinement
goal: How does synaptic pruning in the prefrontal cortex contribute to cognitive flexibility during adolescent development?
summary: The best path is a longitudinal design that measures circuit refinement and behavior in the same animals, while avoiding a claim that pruning alone determines cognition. The ranked program deliberately keeps competing mechanisms separate, then uses perturbation, rescue, and independent-model replication to decide which should advance.

ideas.title: A narrow microglial refinement window calibrates rule shifting
ideas.statement: Transient microglial synapse engagement during mid-adolescence may calibrate later prefrontal rule-shift performance.

ideas.title: Complement tagging separates flexible from persistent synapses
ideas.statement: Complement-associated tagging may preferentially mark a subset of adolescent prefrontal synapses for refinement.

ideas.title: Circuit synchrony mediates the behavior link
ideas.statement: The effect of adolescent refinement on flexibility may be mediated by maturation of prefrontal network synchrony.

title: Ferroptosis Sensitization in Pancreatic Cancer - Open Co-Scientist
description: What are the key molecular regulators of ferroptosis in pancreatic cancer cells, and how might their modulation enhance chemotherapy sensitivity?
heading: Ferroptosis Sensitization in Pancreatic Cancer
goal: What are the key molecular regulators of ferroptosis in pancreatic cancer cells, and how might their modulation enhance chemotherapy sensitivity?
summary: The proposals share a redox-resistance theme. Priority should go to biomarker-stratified combinations with orthogonal death-pathway controls before moving beyond cell and organoid models. The ranked program deliberately keeps competing mechanisms separate, then uses perturbation, rescue, and independent-model replication to decide which should advance.

ideas.title: CPEB1-low tumors depend on NRF2 redox buffering
ideas.statement: CPEB1-low pancreatic cancer models may have a measurable NRF2-buffering state that predicts reduced response to a ferroptosis-inducing combination.

ideas.title: ARID3A-PTEN-GPX4 status selects a chemosensitization subgroup
ideas.statement: An ARID3A-high, PTEN-suppressed subgroup may be selectively sensitized when ferroptosis resistance is relieved during gemcitabine exposure.

ideas.title: Early lipid-peroxidation kinetics predict durable combination response
ideas.statement: Early lipid-peroxidation kinetics may distinguish transient stress from a durable ferroptosis-linked chemosensitization response.
